description: This file contains utility functions for validating Azure Blob storage container and blob names, along with a regex pattern for container name validation. It uses conditional compilation directives to define namespace based on project configuration.

classes.name: AzureBlobUtils
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to validate Azure Blob storage container and blob names.

methods.name: ContainerNameRegex
methods.description: A pre-compiled regex pattern for validating container names, defined with the [GeneratedRegex] attribute.

methods.name: ValidateContainerName
methods.description: Validates that the container name is non-empty, appropriately sized, and matches the regex pattern for container naming rules.

methods.name: ValidateBlobName
methods.description: Validates that the blob name is non-empty, not too long, and does not contain more than 253 slashes.
